bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.intro: Each line is one printer drawn on one segment of one light. A change here applies at once, in the running module.
bindings.multi_room: One printer may sit on more than one light, at the cost of a second steady stream. A segment carries one printer only.
bindings.not_saved: Every change here is written into the module's own configuration store, so it survives a restart and an upgrade. A module purge or a fresh install loses it, so keep a copy of a list you want to keep.
bindings.known_controller: A controller this module already drives…
bindings.empty_body: Add one and it appears on the light the moment it is saved.
bindings.load_failed: The bindings could not be read
bindings.printer_gone: A printer the host no longer holds
bindings.several: one of several bindings for this printer
bindings.no_printer_free: Every printer this module knows is already on this light: name another light, or edit the row it is on
bindings.segment_taken: That segment is already taken on this light by
bindings.whole_takes_all: A whole-light binding leaves no segment for anything else, and a segment leaves none for the whole light.
